title: Policy bundle manifest (C7)
description: manifest.json at the root of policies-<revision>.tar.gz. The archive also contains schema.cedarschema, policies/**/*.cedar and entities/static.json. The signature policies-<revision>.tar.gz.sig is a raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the exact bytes of the .tar.gz file.

gitSha.description: Full commit sha of mcp-policies; its first 7 characters equal the sha part of revision.

schemaVersion.description: Version of mcp-contracts whose cedar/mcp.cedarschema is shipped as schema.cedarschema.
